posts.text: Websol’s results posted decent results but SM is filled with people worrying about Websol’s profit margin’s reducing this quarter. If market’s already did not factor this in, then why would a company growing revenue at 70%+ y-o-y basis be trading at PE of 13? It’s only margin’s falling, not the profit’s falling in absolute numbers. From last 2-3 quarters their cell line was already working at 90%+ capacity. It was only modules line which had capacity to ramp up and grow revenue. Modules are relatively low margin products, so profit margin reduction if revenues increase was known to everyone. T…
